facility.name: My Little College 2
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8600 WURZBACH RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One caregiver did not have current training in CPR/First aid. The certification on hand expired January 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing surface in the infant room has several rips exposing the padding, making the changing surface absorbent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The operation did not notify CCR before adding field trips as a serviced offered. The operation participated on a field trip on July 21, 2026.    Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the service was added, and requirements were discussed with staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two caregivers did not hhave training certificates available for review in required topics; medication administration, hazardous materials, and food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have a training certificate available for review int he required topic; Hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Installation of Smoke Detectors: Smoke detectors were not being maintained as they were heard chirping, indicating that new batteries needed to be installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.5317)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There were several safety hazards observed, including the black plastic lining on the playground under the loose fill was exposed. This is a tripping hazard to children. Cleaning supplies, including Clorox wipes, sanitizing spray, and Febreze spray, were observed to be stored in an unlocked cabinet, thereby making these potentially hazardous materials accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Crib sheets were observed to be either too tight or too loose. The cribs with sheets that fit too tightly were causing the crib mattress to curl upward. The ill-fitting crib sheets is a risk of entanglement because they can easily be removed while the infant is in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver left three children unattended to open the front door for the CCR inspector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two of the three caregiver files reviewed lacked adequate documentation of training hours, indicating insufficient training hours available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director's training did not have certificates in required topics, such as; Medication administration, preventing and responding to food allergies, understanding building and physical premises safety, and hazardous materials available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed utilizing their cell phone  for personal use, texting, while actively supervising group of 10 children during outdoor active play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: A Little Tikes play structure did not have loose-fill leading up to a slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One of the six children's files did not include necessary information for the listed emergency contact, an address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Recited: There were 16 children in care, but the attendance sheet only had 13 children signed in with their time of arrival.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: Recite: During an inspection, an individual arrived to drop off and stated that the procedure to drop off and pick up was that upon arrival they were to wait in the lobby and staff would either take the child or bring the child to them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined in an investigation that good judgment was not practiced when the operation staff delayed the release of children and created a dangerous environment for the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: It was determined through an investigation that arrival times for children was not being documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: It was determined in the investigation that parents and guardians do not have access to their children's classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Five of the ten children's files reviewed did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: A list of the children with food allergies/food intolerances was not posted in the kitchen where the meals and snacks are prepared.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the list of children's allergies/intolerances was posted in the kitchen/food prep area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information for how non-mobile children/children with disabilities would be evacuated in the event of an emergency,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two staff files reviewed did not have training certifictaes for required topics (administering medication and hazardous material).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information on the procedure for reunification in the event of an emergency evacuation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no documentation for a monthly inspections of the fire extinguishers.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspecton when all the fire extinguishers were inspected to include the fire extinguisher in the transporation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: For the month of July there was no documentation that the smoke detectors were tested.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the smoke detectors were tested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: There was no documentation for the testing of the carbon monoxide detectors for the month of July.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the CO2 detectors were tested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four or the six files reviewed did not include updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of the six children's files reviewed did not include healthcare provider statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: There was no documented inspection of battery operated carbon monoxide detectors.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection when all Carbon Monoxide detectors were inspected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A monthly inspection was not being completed.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when an inspection of the operation was conducted utilizing CCR provided general checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit that it kept in the transportation vehicle did not include all necessary items; Guide, tweezers, and thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: One of the six children's files reviewed did not include hearing and vision screening results.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not have documented drills for the months of July and August.   Noted: This was corrected at inspection when a fire drill was conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One of the six children's files reviewed did not include an address for the emergency contact listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: Two of six caregiver files did not have required annual training hours.    CP had 22 hours verified completed.  AP had no record of training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: Five of six staff files did not have a definite employment start date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One of four children's files did not contain a signed healthcare statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: There is no procedure regarding indoor/outdoor active physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of six caregivers did not have pediatric first aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A recently hired employee was in operation caring for children while pending results from background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: A crib was observed to have a mattress that was too small for the crib.  There was an open space that may pose an entrapment risk.    This was corrected at inspection as the director switched another mattress from a crib that was not in use at this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection, a caregiver was observed caring for 16 children with specified age of 3 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - 13 Months to Toddler and Pre K: During inspection, the activity plan for PreK children was observed to have only one 30 minute opportunity for outside play time.  The infant's activity plan did not have a play time slot, and director admitted that they are not taken outside at all.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - 13 Months to Toddler and Pre K (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(B))
